query:
SELECT 
  wowReportStatus,
  updatedAt,
  LEFT(wowReportPdfUrl, 120) as pdf_url,
  LEFT(JSON_EXTRACT(wowReportJson, '$.fourPillars'), 200) as fourPillars_preview
FROM analysis_reports
WHERE clientId = 1149902;
